# Draft:Golden Stars Award

----
The Golden Stars Award was established in 2022 in  Lagos State . The Award  was founded to celebrates and appreciates  individuals and organisations from different part of Nigeria .  Some notable recipients of the Golden Stars include Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu, Whitemoney, Portable , [https://www.vanguardngr.com/2022/06/yeye-osunbukola-honoured-as-woman-pacesetter-of-the-year-at-golden-stars-award-2022/ Yeye Osunbukola], [https://www.vanguardngr.com/2025/06/golden-stars-award-to-honour-gov-sanwo-olu-amb-owoseni/ Oluwaseun Ahmed Owoseni], [https://www.vanguardngr.com/2022/06/yeye-osunbukola-honoured-as-woman-pacesetter-of-the-year-at-golden-stars-award-2022/ Yeye Osunbukola], Hajia Nana Sheik, [https://guardian.ng/news/chibugod-wins-young-media-personality-award-at-golden-stars/ Edeh Chibugod] , David Fasasi, Jibola Oluseyi Abati,Amb. Folasade, Yetunde Adeyemi and several others.
History
The Golden Stars Award was launched in 2022 by [https://www.vanguardngr.com/2024/11/jirons-biography-age-net-worth-and-accolades/ Jimoh Lateef] A , Lead Consultant at Golden Stars Award Entertainment
The 2022 event was chaired by chairman, Ytunde Adeyemi  and was  emerged Most Promising Actress Diaspora award of the year
The 2023 Golden Stars Award  ceremony On Monday, June 19, 2023, Portable was awarded the Golden Star Artist of the Year
The 2025 Golden Stars Award   Jibola Oluseyi Abati, the founder of Taste of African Vibes and pioneer organizer of the African Content Creators Conference won award of dedication and passion for promoting African tourism and content creation.
